Although the paper acknowledges generating "threshold-derived binary reference masks" (Section IV-A), it presents the resulting metrics as definitive real-world evaluation ("on the real NIST benchmark, XCT-SAM achieves the best IoU and Dice scores") without discussing the performance-inflation bias of treating thresholded pseudo-labels as ground truth.
